page.title: 時・場所・方法・理由を聞く

analysis.summaryJa: when・where・how・whyは時・場所・方法・理由という修飾情報の穴を指定する。通常のwh疑問は下降調で情報を求め、聞き返しのエコー疑問は上昇調になりやすい。また前置詞の目的語を尋ねる場合、会話では前置詞を文末に残す形が自然で、改まった文では前置詞をwhomやwhichの前へ出せる。
grammarPoints: whenは時、whereは場所、howは方法、whyは理由を尋ねる
通常の情報wh疑問は下降調が基本である
驚き・聞き返しのwhエコー疑問は上昇調になりやすい
会話ではWho are you traveling with?のように前置詞を文末に残せる
正式な文ではWith whom ...?やBy what time ...?のように前置詞を前置できる
visualEvidence: WHEN・WHERE・HOW・WHYの四つの時計が情報の種類を示す
下降矢印と上昇矢印が通常疑問とエコー疑問の抑揚を対比する
前置詞を文末に残す緑のロープと前へ出す青のロープが描かれる
Who are you traveling with?とWith whom are you traveling?が並べて示される
commonTraps: 通常のwh疑問をyes/no疑問と同じ上昇調だけで読む
前置詞の直後に主格whoを置く正式形を作る
会話で前置詞を文末に残す形を誤りとみなす
howを理由、whyを方法の質問に使う

questions.prompt: ------- will the quarterly meeting begin?
questions.translationJa: 四半期会議はいつ始まりますか。
questions.explanationJa: 開始時刻を尋ねるのでwhenを用います。

questions.prompt: ------- is the nearest parcel drop-off point?
questions.translationJa: 最寄りの荷物持込所はどこですか。
questions.explanationJa: 場所の情報を求めるためwhereが適切です。

questions.prompt: ------- did the technician reset the device?
questions.translationJa: 技術者はどのように装置をリセットしましたか。
questions.explanationJa: リセットの方法を尋ねるのでhowを使います。

questions.prompt: ------- was the order returned to the warehouse?
questions.translationJa: その注文品はなぜ倉庫へ返送されたのですか。
questions.explanationJa: 返送の理由を尋ねるためwhyを使います。

questions.prompt: Who did you discuss the contract -------?
questions.translationJa: その契約について誰と話し合いましたか。
questions.explanationJa: 自然な会話では人をwhoで前に出し、前置詞withを文末に残せます。

questions.prompt: Which account should I transfer the deposit -------?
questions.translationJa: 保証金をどの口座へ振り込めばよいですか。
questions.explanationJa: transfer A to Bの到着先を尋ねるため、前置詞toを文末に残します。

questions.prompt: ------- whom should the signed agreement be sent?
questions.translationJa: 署名済みの契約書はどなた宛てに送るべきですか。
questions.explanationJa: 正式形では前置詞toを前に出し、その直後に目的格whomを置きます。

questions.prompt: ------- which department is this budget allocated?
questions.translationJa: この予算はどの部署に割り当てられていますか。
questions.explanationJa: 正式な前置詞前置でallocate ... toのtoをwhich departmentの前に置きます。

questions.prompt: By ------- time must all visitors leave the building?
questions.translationJa: 来訪者は全員何時までに建物を出なければなりませんか。
questions.explanationJa: 期限を表すbyとwhat timeを組み合わせたBy what timeが適切です。

questions.prompt: The client said the fee was how much -------?
questions.translationJa: 顧客は料金が合計いくらだと言ったのですか。
questions.explanationJa: 聞き返しでは元の文型を保ち、聞き漏らした金額how muchをその位置に置けます。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct question asking about a deadline.

choices.A: Where time must the application be submitted?
choices.B: Why date must the application be submitted?
choices.C: How reason must the application be submitted?
choices.D: When must the application be submitted?

questions.translationJa: 申請書はいつまでに提出する必要がありますか。
questions.explanationJa: 提出時期を尋ねるためwhenを文頭に置きます。

questions.prompt: Choose the natural conversational question.

choices.A: With who are you sharing the office?
choices.B: Who are you sharing the office with?
choices.C: Who with are sharing you the office?
choices.D: Whom are you sharing with the office?

questions.translationJa: 誰とオフィスを共有していますか。
questions.explanationJa: 日常会話ではwhoを文頭にし、withを文末に残す形が自然です。

questions.prompt: Choose the formal version of “Who should I address the letter to?”

choices.A: To who should I address the letter?
choices.B: Whom should to I address the letter?
choices.C: To whom should I address the letter?
choices.D: Who to should I address the letter?

questions.translationJa: その手紙はどなた宛てにすべきでしょうか。
questions.explanationJa: 正式形ではtoを前置し、その後ろに目的格whomを置きます。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct question asking for a method.

choices.A: How can customers activate the warranty?
choices.B: Why can customers activate the warranty method?
choices.D: When method can customers activate the warranty?

questions.translationJa: 顧客はどのように保証を有効化できますか。
questions.explanationJa: 手順・方法を求めるためHow can ...?を使います。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct question asking for a reason.

choices.A: How was the west entrance closed reason?
choices.B: Where reason was the west entrance closed?
choices.C: When cause was the west entrance closed?
choices.D: Why was the west entrance closed?

questions.translationJa: 西側入口はなぜ閉鎖されたのですか。
questions.explanationJa: 閉鎖の原因を求めるためwhyを使います。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct formal question about an allocated fund.

choices.A: For who project was the fund allocated?
choices.B: Which project for was the fund allocated?
choices.C: For which project was the fund allocated?
choices.D: For which project did the fund allocated?

questions.translationJa: その資金はどのプロジェクトに割り当てられましたか。
questions.explanationJa: 正式形ではforをwhich projectの前に置き、受動文was ... allocatedを保ちます。

questions.prompt: Choose the natural conversational question about a recipient.

choices.A: To who did you give the spare key?
choices.B: Who did you give the spare key to?
choices.C: Who to did give you the spare key?
choices.D: Whom did you give to the spare key?

questions.translationJa: 予備の鍵を誰に渡しましたか。
questions.explanationJa: 会話では人をwhoで前に出し、give ... toのtoを文末に残します。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct question asking for a location.

choices.A: When place will the temporary desk be installed?
choices.B: How location will the temporary desk be installed?
choices.C: Why will where the temporary desk be installed?
choices.D: Where will the temporary desk be installed?

questions.translationJa: 仮設デスクはどこに設置されますか。
questions.explanationJa: 設置場所を尋ねるためwhereを使います。

questions.prompt: Choose the formal deadline question.

choices.A: By when time should the report reach your office?
choices.B: What time by should the report reach your office?
choices.C: By what time should the report reach your office?
choices.D: By whose time does the report reach your office?

questions.translationJa: 報告書は何時までにそちらのオフィスへ届くべきですか。
questions.explanationJa: 前置詞byを複合wh句what timeの前に置いたBy what timeが明確な正式表現です。

questions.prompt: Choose the natural echo question after hearing an unclear destination.

choices.B: Where did you ship the samples?
choices.C: You did where ship the samples?

questions.translationJa: サンプルをどこへ発送したと言いましたか。
questions.explanationJa: 聞き返しでは元の平叙文型を保ち、聞き漏らした場所だけをwhereにできます。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to “When does the museum close?”

choices.A: The speaker asks for the museum’s closing time.
choices.B: The speaker asks why the museum closed permanently.
choices.C: The speaker asks where the museum is.
choices.D: The museum is ordered to close now.

questions.translationJa: 話し手は博物館の閉館時刻を尋ねています。
questions.explanationJa: whenは時間の情報を求めます。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to “Who are you traveling with?”

choices.A: The speaker asks how long the trip will take.
choices.B: The speaker asks why the trip was arranged.
choices.C: The speaker asks for the person accompanying the listener.
choices.D: The speaker asks for the destination.

questions.translationJa: 話し手は相手の同行者を尋ねています。
questions.explanationJa: 文末のwithの目的語がwhoという穴になっており、同行者を求めます。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to “With whom will Ms. Ito negotiate?”

choices.A: The speaker asks where negotiations occur.
choices.B: The speaker formally asks who Ms. Ito’s negotiation partner will be.
choices.C: The speaker asks what Ms. Ito will buy.

questions.translationJa: 話し手は伊藤さんの交渉相手を正式な形で尋ねています。
questions.explanationJa: with whomは交渉相手となる人を改まって尋ねます。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to “How did the team reduce costs?”

choices.A: The speaker asks when the team’s costs increased.
choices.B: The speaker asks for the method the team used to reduce costs.
choices.C: The team has not reduced any costs.
choices.D: The speaker asks who approved the costs.

questions.translationJa: 話し手はチームが費用を削減した方法を尋ねています。
questions.explanationJa: howは行為の方法を求めます。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to “Why was my reservation changed?”

choices.A: The speaker wants the reason for the reservation change.
choices.B: The speaker asks where the reservation was made.
choices.D: The speaker asks who owns the hotel.

questions.translationJa: 話し手は自分の予約が変更された理由を尋ねています。
questions.explanationJa: whyは変更の原因・理由を求めます。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to “Which drawer did you put the receipt in?”

choices.A: The receipt is missing from every drawer.
choices.B: The speaker asks for the drawer containing the receipt.
choices.C: The speaker asks who wrote the receipt.
choices.D: The speaker asks when the drawer was purchased.

questions.translationJa: 話し手はレシートを入れた引き出しを尋ねています。
questions.explanationJa: inを文末に残し、which drawerがその目的語の穴を示します。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to “From which office was the notice issued?”

choices.A: The speaker asks who read the notice.
choices.C: The speaker asks how many offices exist.
choices.D: The speaker formally asks which office issued the notice.

questions.translationJa: 話し手はどのオフィスが通知を発行したか正式に尋ねています。
questions.explanationJa: fromをwhich officeの前に出し、発行元を求めます。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to an ordinary falling-tone “Where is the seminar?”

choices.A: The speaker expresses shock at a location just heard.
choices.B: The speaker rejects the seminar location.
choices.C: The speaker already knows the exact venue.
choices.D: The speaker genuinely requests the seminar’s location.

questions.translationJa: 話し手はセミナーの場所を普通に尋ねています。
questions.explanationJa: 通常の下降調wh疑問は不足情報を求める質問として働きます。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to a rising-tone echo “The fee is how much?”

choices.A: The speaker reacts with surprise and asks the amount to be repeated.
choices.B: The speaker asks for an ordinary price list.
choices.C: The speaker agrees to every possible fee.
choices.D: The speaker asks why no fee exists.

questions.translationJa: 話し手は驚き、金額をもう一度聞き返しています。
questions.explanationJa: 文中位置のhow muchと上昇調は聞き返し・驚きを示します。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to “By what date must payment be received?”

choices.A: The speaker asks for the final date by which payment must arrive.
choices.B: The speaker asks who approved the payment.
choices.C: The speaker asks where payment should be sent.

questions.translationJa: 話し手は支払いの最終到着期限を尋ねています。
questions.explanationJa: by what dateは期限となる日を明確に求めます。

questions.prompt: The invitation lists the venue but not the starting hour. ------- does the reception begin?
questions.translationJa: 招待状には会場はありますが開始時刻がありません。披露会はいつ始まりますか。
questions.explanationJa: 欠けている時の情報をwhenで尋ねます。

questions.prompt: The courier left a photo, but I cannot identify the building. ------- was the parcel delivered?
questions.translationJa: 配達員は写真を残しましたが建物が分かりません。荷物はどこに配達されましたか。
questions.explanationJa: 不足している配達場所をwhereで尋ねます。

questions.prompt: The total was reduced by 18 percent, but the report gives no calculation. ------- did the analyst obtain that figure?
questions.translationJa: 合計は18％減っていますが計算方法がありません。分析担当者はその数値をどう算出しましたか。
questions.explanationJa: 計算方法を尋ねるためhowを使います。

questions.prompt: The east gate is closed even though no work is scheduled. ------- is it unavailable?
questions.translationJa: 工事予定がないのに東門が閉まっています。なぜ利用できないのですか。
questions.explanationJa: 閉鎖理由が不足しているのでwhyを使います。

questions.prompt: I know you discussed the complaint, but not the other participant. Who did you speak -------?
questions.translationJa: 苦情について話したことは分かりますが相手が不明です。誰と話しましたか。
questions.explanationJa: speak withの相手をwhoにし、会話ではwithを文末に残します。

questions.prompt: This is a formal letter to a government office. “------- whom should the application be addressed?”
questions.translationJa: これは官公庁への正式な手紙です。「申請書はどなた宛てにすべきですか」。
questions.explanationJa: 正式場面ではTo whomと前置詞を前に出す形が適切です。

questions.prompt: The finance team needs the exact cutoff, not just “Friday.” ------- what time on Friday can transfers be submitted?
questions.translationJa: 財務チームには単なる金曜日ではなく正確な締切が必要です。金曜日の何時まで送金を提出できますか。
questions.explanationJa: 期限を表すuntilをwhat timeの前に置いて正確な時刻を尋ねます。

questions.prompt: We need to identify the budget category. ------- which account should this repair be charged?
questions.translationJa: 予算区分を特定する必要があります。この修理費はどの勘定に計上すべきですか。
questions.explanationJa: charge ... to an accountのtoをwhich accountの前に置く正式形です。

questions.prompt: A: “The replacement costs twelve thousand dollars.” B: “It costs -------?” A: “Twelve thousand.”
questions.translationJa: A「交換品は1万2千ドルです」B「いくらですって」A「1万2千ドルです」。
questions.explanationJa: 聞き漏らした金額だけをhow muchに替え、元の文型で聞き返します。

questions.prompt: The contract names a consultant but not the consultant’s firm. Which company does she work -------?
questions.translationJa: 契約書にはコンサルタント名はありますが所属会社がありません。彼女はどの会社に勤めていますか。
questions.explanationJa: work for a companyの目的語をwhich companyにし、forを文末に残します。
